Liquid Network hit by $320M exploit, transactions halted –
Link
A Bitcoin sidechain settlement layer used by several exchanges, Blockstream's Liquid Network, was drained of roughly 4,000 BTC (≈$320M) by attackers claiming to be "white hats." The network has been fully paused.
Matters because: The exploit adds to a recent run of major crypto hacks and could weigh on confidence in Bitcoin-adjacent infrastructure, even if the damage has been contained to the sidechain rather than BTC spot.

Pendle launches on Robinhood Chain amid broader L2 fund outflows –
Link
Pendle deployed on Robinhood Chain on September 4, debuting its first fixed-income/yield market, sNET, expiring Sept 17, 2026. Separately, on-chain data showed Robinhood Chain posted the largest net outflow (≈$21M) among major L2s in the past 24h, while Arbitrum, Base, Polygon and Hyperliquid also bled funds back toward Ethereum mainnet (≈$46.5M net inflow).
Matters because: new yield products are still launching on newer L2s, but capital appears to be rotating back to Ethereum L1, so Pendle's deployment will be a key test for Robinhood Chain.
